data.name: Bozena
data.gender_notes: Bozena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic name Bogdan, which is made up of two elements: 'Bog' (God) and 'Dan' (man). The name Bozena is thus a feminine form of Bogdan, meaning 'God's strength'. The name Bozena carries the meaning “God's strength” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bozena usually hope their child will grow to embody god's strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bozena belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bozena total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: בוזנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בוזנה מקורו בשפה הצ'כית ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השופט שלי'. השם נגזר מהמילים הצ'כיות 'boh' שפירושו אלוהים ו'zna' שפירושו שופט. השם בוזנה מופיע בשפה העברית בצורה של בוזנה, ומשמעותו היא שהאדם הוא שופטו של אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Μποζένα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Μποζένα προέρχεται από την τσεχική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο κριτής μου'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις τσεχικές λέξεις 'boh' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'zna' που σημαίνει κριτής. Στην ελληνική γλώσσα, το όνομα Μποζένα είναι γνωστό ως Μποζένα και έχει την ίδια σημασία.

in_latin.name: Bozena
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Bozena origine est e lingua Bohemica et significat 'Deus est iudex meus'. Nomen derivatur ex verbis Bohemicis 'boh' quod significat Deum et 'zna' quod significat iudicem. In traditione christiana, nomen Bozena habet significationem spiritualem et refertur ad fidem in Deum.

in_english.name: Bozena
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bozena originates from the Czech language and means 'God is my judge'. It is derived from the Czech words 'boh' meaning God and 'zna' meaning judge. In Christian tradition, the name Bozena has spiritual significance and refers to faith in God as the ultimate judge. It symbolizes a strong connection to divine guidance and wisdom.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bozena holds a rich cultural significance in Slavic and Christian backgrounds. In Slavic mythology, the name is associated with strength, power, and godliness, which is why it was used as a feminine form of Bogdan. From a Christian perspective, Bozena signifies a strong connection with God and the belief in His divine power.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bozena carries an intense spiritual meaning, emphasizing God's presence and strength within an individual. It is a reminder that no matter what the circumstances may be, God's power and strength are always there to guide and support us. Thus, Bozena serves as an inspiration for those seeking faith and empowerment in their lives. With its deep roots in religious traditions, the name Bozena symbolizes the ability to overcome adversities and carry on with the divine strength of the Almighty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bozena: Polish variant of the name Veronica, meaning "bearer of the true vision" or "one who brings the blessed vision to life." This name embodies the spiritual journey of seeking and revealing truth through divine guidance.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bozena was a 13th century Polish noblewoman. The name Bozena carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bozena remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
